saham-idx.description: Indonesian Stock Exchange (IDX) data provider with 958 stocks, historical data from 2019, and multi-source fallback

supportedTools.name: get_market_overview
supportedTools.description: Get IHSG index value, change, trading volume/value, market status, top gainers/losers

supportedTools.name: get_stock_info
supportedTools.description: Get detailed stock information including price, ratios, and market cap

supportedTools.name: get_historical_data
supportedTools.description: Get historical price data from July 2019 to present

supportedTools.name: get_sector_performance
supportedTools.description: Get performance data for all IDX sectors

supportedTools.name: search_stocks
supportedTools.description: Search stocks by company name or ticker from 958 available stocks

supportedTools.name: get_stock_analysis
supportedTools.description: Get comprehensive technical analysis with indicators and recommendations

tickers.description: Array of 2-5 stock ticker symbols to compare

supportedTools.name: get_available_stocks
supportedTools.description: Get complete list of 958 IDX stocks with LQ45 categorization and banking sector identification

supportedTools.name: get_dataset_info
supportedTools.description: Get repository info, last update, total stocks, cache statistics, data coverage range
